name: East Germany (1949–1959)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, red and gold.
history: The plain black, red and gold tricolour adopted by the German Democratic Republic at its formation on 7 October 1949, on the proposal of Friedrich Ebert Jr., and identical to the flag of the Federal Republic. On 1 October 1959 the GDR added its emblem of hammer, compass and wheat wreath to distinguish the two.
